subject: Cypress Health - Access evidence intake & SCIM sync plan
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@cypresshealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Apr 2025 14:15:00 +0100
Subject: Initial access artifacts and timeline

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As discussed with Jonas, Cypress Health is moving into the SIG/SOC2 intake and we need to assemble an access controls packet focused on SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and RBAC mappings.

To keep the intake tight for our internal auditors, can you confirm whether you can provide the following by next Friday (2025-04-11):
- SAML metadata + entity IDs for both prod and staging
- Example SCIM delta export (last 30 days) or a small sample CSV if a delta export is not possible
- Role/access matrix mapping (service accounts and admin roles highlighted)
- One-page description of how least-privilege is enforced for service accounts and elevated roles

We can share a short procurement playbook once we have the artifacts, and Procurement may request a DocuSign amendment for SLAs after review. I copied our security consultant Mike in case there are technical follow-ups.

If you prefer, we can run a 30-minute technical intake tomorrow (04/04) afternoon CET — suggest 15:00 CET; happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Security Program Manager
Cypress Health

Attachments: none

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@cypresshealth.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Apr 2025 15:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Initial access artifacts and timeline

Emma — thanks, great to connect earlier.

Quick answers and next steps:
1) We can provide the SAML metadata for prod and staging. I attached saml_metadata.xml and a short schematic (cypress_saml_schematic.pdf) that shows expected assertion attributes (NameID, email, groups, role).
2) For SCIM: we can generate a 7–14 day sample delta export; I'll ask Irene to pull a small anonymized CSV to show schema and delta fields.
3) Role matrix: attached access_intake_checklist.pdf is our suggested intake checklist — it includes a template for Role/Permission mapping and a column for service account justification. Please use that template if you want us to pre-populate fields.
4) Least-privilege note: see section "Service account controls" on page 2 of the checklist. In short — short-lived API keys for ephemeral services, scoped token policies for internal infra, and quarterly entitlement reviews with owner attestations. We enforce canary rollouts for any role changes that affect more than 10 users.

Meeting: 04/04 15:00 CET works for us — reserving 30 minutes. I'll create a calendar invite and include a shared Drive link for artifacts.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- access_intake_checklist.pdf (4 pages)
- saml_metadata.xml (SAML 2.0 metadata for staging/prod)
- cypress_saml_schematic.pdf (diagram)
